fusions.name: Planish and True
fusions.desc: A light, placed tap that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dead Level
fusions.desc: A flat, heavy blow that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignores armour and stuns each one for 1 second.

fusions.name: Dents Made Good
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Eight Even Blows
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you deal 5% more damage per stack (38% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
